name: CSO_PIPELINE_ITEMS
description: This table contains Items for the Pipelines to process.  Data in here will be short-lived as it is processed and removed by the Pipeline Service.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Unique Primary Key for this table.

columns.name: PIPELINE_ID
columns.description: ID of the Pipeline; used to store items and logs for this specific pipeline.

columns.name: ITEM_ID
columns.description: ID of the item in the pipeline, to be used by implementation code to identify this item in another system.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: The type of the item being stored, used by implementation code to determine which type of item is being handled.

columns.name: ACTION
columns.description: The name of the action intended for this item in the pipeline: CREATE, UPDATE, or DELETE.

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: A numerical priority where lower is higher, used to prioritize items in the pipeline.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
